title: Wire transport contract (Go-only stub, R2 wedge #4)
depends_on: ADR-0029 (rust-vs-go-port policy — Go is canonical for wire transport)
enables: R3 implementation of the actual transport (HTTP / gRPC / UDS) behind the contract
spec 027+ event-stream wire shape (surface invalidation push, lease state change)
scope_in: WireEnvelope Go type: envelope { envelope_id, tenant_id, msg_type, payload, signature, sent_at_unix_ms }
WireMessage Go interface: one per msg_type (ProbeRequest/ProbeResponse, ReplanRequest/ReplanResponse, SurfaceInvalidateRequest, LeaseStateChange, Heartbeat)
Stable JSON wire schema for each WireMessage (the bytes-on-wire contract)
WireError taxonomy with stable error codes (BadEnvelope/UnsupportedMsgType/AuthFailed/Bug/Io)
cmd/wire Go package — pure contract, zero net dependencies (no net/http, no grpc, no UDS)
WireCodec: Marshal/Unmarshal/Validate (deterministic-JSON v1: sorted keys, no whitespace, RFC3339Nano timestamps)
13 unit tests in cmd/wire/wire_test.go (round-trip per msg_type, error paths, validation)
scope_out: Actual network transport (HTTP / gRPC / Unix domain socket) — R3
TLS / mTLS handshake — R3 (depends on trust_root.rs per spec 021)
Authentication beyond envelope signature — R3 (WireAuth is a separate spec)
Rate limiting / QoS shaping — separate spec
fabric-graph-cli Rust side — Go is canonical for wire transport per ADR-0029
Replace subprocess model of spec 023 (still subprocess + JSON; wire transport is a different layer)
acceptance_signals: WireCodec.Marshal(WireCodec.Unmarshal(x)) == x round-trip for each of the 5 msg_types
WireError codes match spec 025 §3.4 stable list
JSON wire schemas stable: 5 fixtures committed under cmd/wire/testdata/
No new runtime deps in cmd/wire/go.mod (stdlib only)
